nodes.label: TalentsTest.kt
TalentsTest
.`the catalog has the 10 talents of the four branches with the values of the spec`()
Test
.`units are seconds, points or percent`()
.`the combo talent reads Limite de dano do combo and gives 5 percent a level up to 50`()
.`the click damage percent talent gives 5 percent a level up to 50`()
.`the flat click damage talent gives 1, 3, 5 and so on up to 19`()
.`the catalog has 3 grades of the 10 talents, grade N giving N times the value of grade 1`()
.`a grade is locked until the previous grade is at level 10 and grade 1 is always open`()
.`a locked grade refuses the upgrade`()
.`a grade level costs its grade in points and the spent points add them up`()
.`an unknown talent is not found`()
.`a first clear pays no point for a phase, 2 for a miniboss and 5 for a chapter boss`()
.`the award key names the position so a replay of it has the same key and another position another key`()
.`the points follow the settings`()
.`rules reject a cost below 1 and negative points`()
.`a new player has level 0 and 0 points and every next cost is 1`()
.`an upgrade with 3 points raises the level by one and spends 1`()
.`the points spent are the sum of the levels`()
.`an upgrade with no available point is refused and changes nothing`()
.`a request made for another level than the stored one is a mismatch and changes nothing`()
.`an upgrade from level 0 of a talent already at 1 is a mismatch`()
.`a talent at level 10 refuses the upgrade as max level and has no next cost`()
.`at level 9 the next cost is 1 and the upgrade reaches 10, which gives the combo talent 50`()
.`the value of a talent is its level times the per level amount`()
.`a seen level must be an integer from 0 to the max level`()
.`stored levels must be in the catalog and between 1 and 10 and the earned points not negative`()
